Commercial Sewer Line Services

Camera inspection, spot repairs and full line replacement for the lines your whole building ties into.

Get a Quote Call 803-600-4357

What It Is

Every drain in your building flows into the building sewer and out to the city main. When that line cracks, sags or fills with roots, the whole property feels it. We inspect, repair and replace it.

Signs You Need It

  • Repeated backups across the building
  • Sewer odor inside or outside
  • Sinking pavement or wet spots near the line
  • Slow drains on the lowest level

What To Expect

We start with a camera inspection to locate the problem and see the condition of the line. Then we lay out the repair options and schedule the work to keep your business running where we can.

Commercial Services

What We Handle

  • Sewer Camera Inspection

    A camera inspection shows the full condition of the building sewer, including roots, cracks, offsets and sags. It's the basis for every repair decision.

    What's included

    • Video inspection of the sewer line
    • Locating problem spots and depth
    • Findings explained in plain language
    • Repair recommendations

    Common signs you need this

    • Repeat backups
    • Planning a property purchase or renovation
    Set Up an Account

  • Spot Repairs

    When the damage is in one section, we repair just that section. It limits disruption to your parking lot, landscaping and operations.

    What's included

    • Pinpointing the damaged section
    • Excavating only the repair area
    • Replacing the broken pipe
    • Backfill and flow test

    Common signs you need this

    • Single break or root intrusion on camera
    • Localized wet or sunken area
    Set Up an Account

  • Line Replacement

    When a sewer line is failing along its length, replacement is the lasting fix. We install new pipe and cleanouts and coordinate the work around your hours where we can.

    What's included

    • Removal of the failed line
    • New sewer pipe installed to code
    • New cleanouts where needed
    • Flow test and site cleanup

    Common signs you need this

    • Collapsed or crushed pipe
    • Multiple breaks along the line
    • Old clay or cast iron failing
    Set Up an Account

  • Building Drains & Stacks

    Inside the building, drain lines and vertical stacks carry waste from every floor down to the sewer. We repair leaking, cracked and corroded sections.

    What's included

    • Inspection of drain lines and stacks
    • Repair or replacement of failed sections
    • Cleanout access where needed
    • Leak and flow check

    Common signs you need this

    • Leaks from overhead drain lines
    • Sewer odor in a chase or ceiling
    • Corroded cast iron drain pipe
    Set Up an Account
